summary: Shen Feizhi continues to monitor Gu Suizhou's progress while maintaining a professional distance. Gu Suizhou, meanwhile, is orchestrating a fake romance with 'Number 9' to manipulate Shen Feizhi's attention, though his attempts at 'romance reports' via social media are largely ignored by Shen. Gu Suizhou reveals a manipulative and cold side when dealing with Number 9, using the man's debt to force him into a charade. The chapter ends with Gu Suizhou asking to move into Shen Feizhi's villa, prompting Shen to question his true intentions with his associate, C2.
